title: Tamsin and the Asset
author: August Joubert
blurb: Juniper Galloway, a fixer for an embassy that doesn't officially exist, has spent seven years following rules that keep getting rewritten. Then a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must burn the network that did the training before the markets open in Frankfurt.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
